component.name: moogle
component.summary: moogle markdown: a distraction-free Markdown editor

description.p: moogle is a Markdown editor based on KDE's ghostwriter. It keeps ghostwriter's distraction-free writing environment, live preview, themes and export options, and adds an in-place rendered view (Ctrl+Shift+V) that keeps scroll position, cursor and selection when swapping between raw Markdown and the rendered document.
